validate.failNote: Real defects: fix them before the prototype goes to review or handoff.
validate.reviewNote: The script cannot decide these. A designer looks at each one and either fixes it or records why it is fine.
validate.shotsNote: Screenshots are in shots/, highlighted differences in diffs/. After a human has looked at them, accept them as the new baseline with: validation.py baseline --app <app>.
